high_level_description: stc brand style, a moody nighttime cityscape featuring a mosque and a cellular tower.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark blue-gray sky, white buildings with flat roofs in the foreground, and modern high-rise buildings silhouetted in the distance, shot from an elevated perspective in a wide aspect ratio with black borders.

elements.desc: A mosque with two tall minarets, white walls, and arched windows, silhouetted against the sky.
A tall cellular phone tower with multiple antennas standing on the left side of the frame.
